name: Model schema command
responsibility: Prints the JSON Schemas that the consumer skill names, through the model contract, with no server and no vault
description: archboard model schema lists the names, and archboard model schema <name> prints one: the model manifest, a module, a flow collection, the initialization, edit, import and migration requests, and the vault configuration. The model contract prints them from its own schemas through describeModelSchema, so they match the installed program, and the site's reference reads the same operation. The skill reads them here, so a copy of the skill from GitHub, as the skills CLI installs it, needs no generated file.
